d: CloudEngine S5735-L48P4XE-A-V2 - 48 × Gigabit PoE+ access ports, 4 × 10G SFP+ uplink ports, 2 × 12GE stack ports, built-in AC power, Layer 3 managed access switch.

specs.label: Layer 2 features
specs.value: VLAN, Voice VLAN, STP, RSTP, MSTP, LLDP / LLDP-MED / CDP, Port mirroring (SPAN)

specs.label: Layer 3 features
specs.value: Static routing, RIP, OSPF, EIGRP, Policy-based routing (PBR), IPv4 / IPv6 Dual Stack, OSPF / OSPFv3, Policy-Based Routing (PBR)

specs.label: Security features
specs.value: 802.1X authentication, MAC authentication bypass, DHCP snooping, Access Control Lists (ACLs)

specs.label: Performance & reliability
specs.value: Redundant fan modules, Non-blocking architecture, Enterprise-grade MTBF

specs.label: Multicast
specs.value: IGMP v1, IGMP v2, IGMP v3, IGMP Snooping, PIM Sparse Mode (PIM-SM)

specs.label: QoS (Quality of service)
specs.value: Hardware-based QoS at wire speed, Traffic classification & marking (CoS / DSCP), Priority queuing for voice & video, Policing, shaping, CIR, Up to 8 egress queues per port, Queue Management, DSCP Support

specs.label: Security
specs.value: IEEE 802.1X Port-based Authentication, MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB), ACLs (IPv4 / IPv6 / MAC), DHCP Snooping, Dynamic ARP Inspection (DAI), IP Source Guard, Web Authentication (WebAuth)
